statements.t: As we look forward to fiscal 2027, we currently expect to deliver between 12,000 and 13,000 lots, generating $1.4 billion to $1.5 billion of revenue.
We will continue to balance the pace and price of lot sales with the timing of our investments to meet demand and maximize returns in each of our projects.”
The Company plans to release financial results for its first quarter ended December 31, 2026 on January 19, 2027 before the market opens.
